set.body:
Outcome

Model masks and labels with image4s value semantics and model clusters or atlases as exact locus4s maps, with dense realizations derived rather than redundantly owned.

Work

- Use Mask images for Boolean sampled support and Categorical images for integer label realizations.
- Replace ClusteredNeuroVol with a PartialSurjection from the exact voxel domain to an exact parcel domain plus parcel metadata and provenance.
- Replace ClusteredNeuroVec with parcel-domain data shaped (parcel,time) plus the authoritative assignment; remove duplicate full clMap, mask, cluster vector, and derived dense map ownership.
- Express dense and sparse trial, feature, channel, and direction data through image4s non-spatial axes rather than NeuroHyperVec.
- Rebase the pending exact atlas publication work onto direct GridDomain and canonical parcel fields, preserving exact volume and surface realizations while deleting legacy ordinal compensation.

Acceptance

- Cluster fibers, labels, centroids, parcel order, parcel series, and dense categorical realizations derive from one authoritative PartialSurjection.
- Same-size reordered parcel domains fail unless a caller supplies a certified Bijection.
- No cluster or atlas type caches two complete assignment representations.
- Exact atlas publication, Schaefer variants, foreign-producer fixtures, and volume or surface identity courts pass on JVM and Scala.js.
- The pending atlas realization commit is rebuilt or split and is not merged with legacy bridge behavior.
set.title: Recast masks labels clusters and parcel series as semantic images and exact maps
